'''Bryna Lisbet''' is the [[Wisdom]] of [[Tobin's Hollow]].
== History ==
Bryna is a [[wilder]] as a village Wisdom on [[Toman Head]]. When the [[Seanchan]] come to occupy the region, Bryna does manage to escape, but reveals her [[channeling]] abilities in doing so, and the Seanchan send a patrol after her.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
